cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-ask-betrayal: All that talk about democracy, freeing the slums… that was bullshit then ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-ask-people-fate: What happens to the people here ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-den-infer-role: They sent you here ? You're Golden Herd ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-den-plans-ask-settle: So, what, they plan on settling ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-heard-enough: I've heard enough. I'm putting a stop to this. [Fight]
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-pillaging: They've been killing and pillaging. Sounds a lot like raiders to me.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-pillaging-defy: So, whoever wins decides what's right, is that it ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-pillaging-defy-start: Oh yeah ? I'm stronger than you though. So you won't mind if I stop you right here. [Start fight]
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-role-further: So you don't just work for the Golden Herd, you're one of them.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-slave-exploit: Sounds like an excuse to exploit ponies.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd-slave-justify: Are you seriously defending some kind of fair slavery ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/asked-when: As soon as the siege of Thornhoof ends with the Herd victorious.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/asked-when-: I've received news that Thornhoof was defeated. The Golden Herd will head to Crystal Den anytime now.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/entry:
The Crystal Wasteland's different. It has more to build on. Easier to rule. At least, some in the Herd believe that.

They're thinking beyond the old ways of the Herd.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/give-missio:
Now let me ask you. You've been useful to me so far. And maybe your role in my work is not over yet.

Are you still going to work with us ? My master can reward you handsomely.
Wise choice. My ponies will get you when the time is right. For the time being, stay put, and don't spill any of what we've talked about. The Golden Herd doesn't like traitors very much.
Ah, well. I was afraid you'd say that. It wasn't really an option though. I can't really let you go after all you've heard.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/herd-plotte: Those of us who are tired of running towards the horizon. Who understand our era of nomadism is over. It fitted the early days of the wastelands, and served us well. But it's time to move on to the next step. My tribe understands that. Which is why I was sent here.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/on-betrayal:
When has democracy been anything but bullshit ? It's the wasteland, baby. What you don't take, you don't get.

I might be smoothing things around the edges a little bit, but ponies will have more freedom under the Herd than they ever did under the Potioks. At least, their freedom will be earned through their efforts, rather than who their friends and families are.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/on-takeover: I'm preparing a smooth transition. The Herd is going to come anyway, and if I do my job well, there won't be too much bloodshed. Something better for everypony, don't you think ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/people-fate: Most will adapt. Some will rise. The rest will serve. Whichever it is, they will become part of something bigger.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-cristal-den/settle: Yup. That's the plan. Crystal Den will make a nice capital. It has food, infrastructure, population… all it lacks is the right direction. That's why I'm here.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-role/entry:
Oh yes. I'm the personal and most trusted slave to Stormhide, chief of the Grass Manes, the most cunning tribe of the Golden Herd.

I've been advising him about Crystal Den for a long time. And I'm here, on his mandate, to accomplish our projects.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-strong-herd: Heh. Not many ponies see that, around these parts. Yes. They are strong. But it's not just brute force. It's discipline. Values. Know-how. I know they have a reputation of savagery around these parts, but the Golden Herd is so much more than that.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/about-thornhoof: Yeah. They are. For now. But Thornhoof's stockpile won't last forever, and the Golden Herd knows how to live from the land. Thornhoof will fall, eventually.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/entry: That's the usual story, yeah. Ponies cope about losing to them by calling them all sorts of names. But the truth is… they're organized. Fit for the wasteland. Everypony know their place, and everpony pulls their weight. That's more that I can say about most places around there.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/pillaging: What can I say ? It's a harsh world out there, and when there's not enough resource for everypony, ponies fight for resources. That's just how it is. If the Golden Herd comes out on top, it  doesn't make them worse than anypony hoarding resources for themselves, behind some tall walls. It just makes them stronger.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/pillaging-defy: It's always been this way, pal.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/slavery:
Yeah, they do take prisoners, and put them to work.

But don't confuse it with whatever you see in this city. In the Golden Herd, slaves aren't a mere convenience that works until death catch up to them.

Weakness leads them to slavery. And through work, they earn respect, freedom, and may even rise.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/slavery-exploit: Everything is exploitation. Difference is, we're honest about it.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/slavery-justify:
What's fair is whatever brings out the best in everypony, and makes us all thrive.

Are you gonna teach me a lesson about the magic of friendship ? That worked in the ideal world of before, assuming that even ever existed anywhere else than in some old books.

Turns out that in this buckin' world of pony eats pony, what works best is coercicion. And unlike these moronic Potioks and their slaver friends, the Golden Herd is good at it.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/defend/slavery-push: I don't just believe. I know from personal experience. I am one of their slaves.
cristal-den/bibin.about-herd/intro:
Straight to the point, huh ? Okay. You've earned some honesty.

Yeah. I know the Golden Herd. In fact, I know them quite well. What's it to you ?
cristal-den/bibin.about-necessary-actions:
The Cristal wastes are divided into a bunch of factions, fighting for their turf, exploiting ponies for riches… there ain't no idea of general interest no more, everypony just fend for themselves or their little group.

We need to grow into something bigger. More united. We need to get everypony to work together. That requires ambition. And ruthlessness. Because the ponies who currently rule the broken pieces of these wastes, they're so greedy that they'd rather die than lose their authority.

So we're going to force them to. Ponies will hurt. Ponies will die. But when our work is over, ponies will thrive once again.
cristal-den/bibin.accept-to-work-for-price: Heh. I'll do about anything if you can afford me.
cristal-den/bibin.accept-to-work-gracefully: Alright. I'm trusting you. I'll do your job.
cristal-den/bibin.ask-about-golden-herd: So, it seems you have ties with the Golden Herd. Care to explain ?
cristal-den/bibin.ask-about-job: Hey, earlier you said something about wanting my help ?
cristal-den/bibin.ask-about-job#2: So, do you have more work for me ?
cristal-den/bibin.ask-about-project: You say you want to do what no one's ready to do to improve the Cristal waste. What do you mean exactly ?
cristal-den/bibin.caught-attention-ask-who: Oh, well, I'm here, hehe ! Er… who are you again ?
cristal-den/bibin.caught-attention-curious: Why did you want to see me ?
cristal-den/bibin.enforcer-ask-cautious: That sounds radical. Aren't you afraid the situation's going to escalate ?
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers-accept-job-enthusiast: Blowing stuff up ? Now that's more like it ! I'll do it !
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers-ask-about-payment: Risky job. It's going to cost you extra.
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers-trigger-report: I took care of the enforcers weapon stash.
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers/about-caution: That's the end goal, pal. The situation will escalate. As long as the few rule the many through tyranny, it's going to escalate anyway, with or without our help. We didn't start the violence, it was already there. With our help, however, the enforcers' ability to successfully rule through violence will diminish.
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers/about-payment: Of course. Those who fight for the freedom of others deserve a fitting reward. And we're not just paying you in respect, though you'll get lots of it as well. I'll offer you {{enforcersReward}} on completion. Is that alright ?
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers/accepted:
Nice. Here, I've got some explosives for you.

He gives you dynamite.

Good luck. The slums are counting on your success !
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers/intro:
Oh yeah. I think you're ready for something more serious. A bit more involved. Today we're putting an end to the oppression in the Crystal Den. The town's enforcers will enforce no more.

I want you to get inside the "police" station, in the town's center. Down in the basement, there's a weapon stash. Find a way to get inside, and blow it up.
cristal-den/bibin.enforcers/report:
Tartarus, YES ! We could see the fireworks from over here ! Good job, pal ! Here's your reward, you earned it.

He gives you {{enforcersReward}} caps.
cristal-den/bibin.entry/caught-attention: Ah, you're finally there ! I've been expecting you. Everypony's been talking about you lately. I want to know what the fuss is all about !
cristal-den/bibin.entry/default: Hey. What's up ? Anything you need from me ?
cristal-den/bibin.entry/introduction: I'm Bibin. Owner of this place and benevolant leader of the Cristal Den slums.
cristal-den/bibin.entry/intruder/intro: Interesking skill you have. Alright, you've got my attention. Would you like to work for me ? I think I might be able to put you to good use.
cristal-den/bibin.entry/intruding: Hey. I'm pretty sure you're not supposed to be there. How did you get past the guard ?
cristal-den/bibin.entry/no-more-work:
Afraid not, pal. There's still much to do, but… let's just say the timing isn't right.

Maybe later. In the meantime, enjoy my establishment. You've been such a great little helper, I aksed them to lower the prices for you.
cristal-den/bibin.herd-ask-about: I don't know much about them.
cristal-den/bibin.herd-ask-about-plans: What do they want with the Crystal Den ?
cristal-den/bibin.herd-give-positive-opinion: I've heard they're strong. They value honor and discipline.
cristal-den/bibin.herd-mission-accept: Sure, I'd like that very much.
cristal-den/bibin.herd-mission-not-mercenary: I'm not a mercenary. And I don't approve of what you're doing. I won't work for you anymore.
cristal-den/bibin.intruding-friendly-sneak: I have a knack for getting by unnoticed.
cristal-den/bibin.intruding-murder-intent: Who cares about your guard ? You should be worrying about yourself. En garde !
cristal-den/bibin.intruding-reject-job: I'm sorry, I shouldn't even be there. I'll be on my way !
cristal-den/bibin.intruding-take-job: Yeah, sure, I have some free time ahead of me. What do you need ?
cristal-den/bibin.job-proposal:
Hmhm. I have big plans for this town. For the whole Crystal wasteland, actually. With your help, we can change this wasteland into a better, safer place… but it ain't gonna be easy, and nopony wants to take the necessary actions to reach that goal. Nopony but us.
We need ponies like you. Strong-willed. Competent. Trustworthy. I want you to work for us. And ultimately, I want you to become one of us. What do you say ?
cristal-den/bibin.job-proposal-return: Let's get back to the main topic, alright ? I have a job for you. Will you do it for me ?
cristal-den/bibin.job-refusal: Aw, you break my heart, buddy ! But I like the cut of your jib. Come back if you change your mind.
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-action-bullshit-hostile: I've heard enough. You're evil. The world will be better off without you. [Start fighting]
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-action-bullshit-neutral: I won't fight against you. But I can't help you either.
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-action-doubts: So altruistic. I have to wonder, do you believe in your own bullshit, or did you just think I would ?
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-action-ends-justify-means: The end justify the means, then ? You'd do just about anything if it's for a good cause ?
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-action-moral-objection: Forfeiting your soul on the off chance that it might have positive consequences doesn't sound like a good deal at all.
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-actions/called-bullshit: Hey. You can think whatever you want, buddy. Ultimately, all that matters to me is whether you'll fight with me or against me. So… what will it be ?
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-actions/ends-and-means:
It's a simplistic way to put it. I read a book once, written by a diplomat under King Sombra's rule. It pretty much said that a good ruler isn't one who bends to moral principles, but rather one who can be ruthless.

The ruler who bends to moral principles will always be outplayed by those who don't follow any rules. Ultimately, their rule will only lead to chaos, misery, war.

I am not a good pony. And I am more than willing to get my hooves dirty in the name of stability, prosperity and peace.
cristal-den/bibin.necessary-actions/objected-morale: It's not like the ponies I'm fighting against are any better than this. And anyway, let's just say I'm the kind of pony who'd rather fail at something than not even try. Wouldn't you agree ?
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/accepted: That's the spirit ! Here are the coordinates, get there as fast as you can !
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/failure-reported:
Hm. You disappoint me. I really thought we had something going, you and me, but I guess I was wrong.

Welp. I have no more uses for you, and I have to cut loose ends. I'm sure you get it.
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/how:
Sure, why not ? I fully trust that you'll deliver. You have a knack for it, I can tell.
But hey, if you'd rather avoid using violence, maybe you can find a way to distract the enforcers' attention. All we need is for my pals to escape from there safe and sound.
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/intro: Yeah, you're right on time. Some pals of mine just radioed me. They've been pinned down by the enforcers, north of town, near the river. They could use some help. I want you to flank those potiok goons, get them off their tails.
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/report-failure: You do ? I'd have expected to hear the news from them first. What's up ?
cristal-den/bibin.pinnedHerd/report-success:
Yes, they got in touch with me, told me you did a swell job. I just knew you wouldn't disappoint !

Here's your payment, as usual.
He gives you {{rescueReward}} caps.
cristal-den/bibin.potiok-assassination-report: I took care of the Potiok once and for all.
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/accept-enthusiast: About time. That ass kicking is long overdue.
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/accepted:
That's what I'm talking about ! Listen, I know I said you had to cut the serpent's head, but it's more like a hydra. We have to make sure the phoenix doesn't rise from the ashes of its predecessor, right ?

So you need to kill the Matriarch, but you also need to kill the heirs: Pat, Bitty and Crafty. The Matriarch, Pat and Crafty are in town, at the Potiok Ranch. Bitty is at the coal mine, in Hillburrow. I'm sure you'll manage somehow. Good luck !
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/already-done:
Well, I would've asked you to murder some Potioks for me but... seems like you already did the job. You're just the gift that keeps on giving !

Come back later, something might still come up.
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/intro:
Do I have a job for you ? Oh yes, I do. The most important job of your life.

It's time to get serious. It's time to end the Potiok rule over this town. I want you to get down in their lair and cut the serpent's head. How do you feel about that ?
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/reject-fight: I feel you must be crazy if you think I'll pick a nutjob like you over the Potioks.
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/reject-preacefully: This is going too far. I'm sorry, but I don't want to get involved.
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/rejected:
Damn, I really should stop taking bets, I'm just not good at it. I really liked the cut of your jib too.

So sad. I can't let you go now. Who knows who you're going to talk to ?
cristal-den/bibin.potiokAssassination/report:
Yes, I heard ! The whole town is singing your praise ! Finally free of the Potiok tyranny ! Good job ! Here, take this, you earned it... hero.

He gives you {{potiokAssassinationReward}} caps.
cristal-den/bibin.refuse-to-work: I'm a simple pony. I don't care to get involved in some big scheme or power struggle. Sorry, but I'm out.
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-accept-alt: Alright, I'll see what I can do.
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-accept-directly: Nice, some real action at last ! Where do I go ?
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-ask-how: You expect me to take down a full squad of Crystal Den scouts ?
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-bring-up-golden-herd: About these "friends" of yours… care to tell me how you got acquainted with the Golden herd ?
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-failed-bring-up-golden-herd: I didn't know your friends where Golden Herd scum. Care to explain ?
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-failed-justify: We put up a fight. But they didn't make it.
cristal-den/bibin.rescue-trigger-report: I've got news about your friends.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-ask-more-payment: This suitcase is probably worth much more than that. Make it {{increasedSabotageReward}} and we have a deal.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-ask-more-payment-again: No, I don't think you will. You're taking the risk of sending an outsider to ship something important to this "friend" of yours. It seems like you don't want people to know you two are related. Now I don't know what's going on, but I can tell this job is worth more caps than this.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-ask-payment: I don't mind, but this sounds important. How much are you willing to pay me ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-report-ask-reward: Woh there, wait a minute. We agreed on a reward, didn't we ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-report-confirm-delivery: Yes, I gave the suitcase to Mighty Hobo.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-report-exit: I'll be on my way, then.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-report-no-password: I didn't get one. Your guy over there was pretty weird, it must've slipped his mind.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-saboteur-is-dead: Er… you mean the water carrier from Hillburrow ? Because I'm pretty sure he's dead.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage-trigger-report: I need to talk to you about the suitcase delivery.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/about-payment: For starters, you'll be rewarded with some of my trust. Which will open up new jobs for you. With more… substantial rewards.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/about-suitcase-contents: Buddy, you don't need to know that. It's better if you don't. Just do the deed and come back. Can you do that for me ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/accept-more-payment:
He winces for a moment, and goes:

You're a frightening pony, you know ! I don't know why, I just feel compelled to give you what you want ! {{sabotageReward}} caps it is !
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/accept-payment: You drive a hard bargain. Alright then ! How about {{sabotageReward}} caps ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/intro:
Here's the thing. I need you to deliver something for me.

He picks up a suitcase from under his desk and gives it to you.

I want you to take this to Hillburrow. There's a good friend of mine who lives there. His name is Mighty Hobo. Big earth pony, darkish green furr. You can't miss him. He works as a water carrier. When he's not doing his shifts, you can find him in a shack on the outskirts of town, near a well. Do not open the suitcase. If you open the suitcase, he will know, and he won't be happy with you. And if you don't deliver the suitcase, I will know, and I won't be happy with you. Got it ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/on-job-accepted:
Nice ! Now remember : big, earth pony, dark green fur, working as a water carrier. He roams town between 14 to 18. The rest of the time, he's probably resting in his shack, or at the bar.

Oh, one last thing : don't forget to ask him for the password. That's how I'll know you completed the delivery.

Off you go then ! Tell him I said hi, and to keep up the good work !
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reject-more-payment: Come on, I'm already going out of my way for you. I could get any of my friends here to make the delivery for free if I wanted to. I'm offering you {{sabotageReward}} caps, and if you won't take it, I'll find somepony else.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reporting: Ah, what's the word ? How's Mighty doing ? Did you deliver the suitcase ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reporting-confirm-complete: You know, I had a good feeling about you. Seems I wasn't wrong. You've done well. You don't even know how much good you've done today. Come back soon, I have more planned for you.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reporting-confirm-entry: Good ! Not that I don't trust you of course, but you were supposed to get a password from Mighty. Care to tell me what it was ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reporting-no-password:
Oh, buddy… I am so, so disappointed… I trusted you. I thought you were smarter than that. And you even came back, without the password ? Didn't you know what would happen ? Such a tragic ending…

Guard ! Come in and get rid of this fool. Definitively.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/reporting-reward: Of course, we did ! Here you go, {{sabotageReward}} caps, as we agreed. You deserved it.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/water-carrier-dead: What ? You're shitting me, right ? He's dead ? How would you know that ? What happened ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/water-carrier-death-by-player: You ? You better have a damn good reason for this. This set back will cost me… and you. Explain yourself.
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/water-carrier-death-evasive: You heard about it ? From who ?
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/water-carrier-death-insulted: You come here to tell me my pony over there died, you don't want to tell me what happened, AND you play smart with me ? Are you fucking suicidal ? Because I'm about to grant your death wish. GUARDS !
cristal-den/bibin.sabotage/water-carrier-death-peaceful-en: I see… thanks for bringing this to my attention. Forget about this job. I'll find something else for you to do… come back later.
cristal-den/bibin.saboteur-accept-job: Sure. I'll do it. [Take the suitcase]
cristal-den/bibin.saboteur-ask-money: Look, if you're looking for free labor, there's a slave market a few blocks away. But if you want me to do the job, then you're gonna have to pull out some caps.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death-explained-cocky: You know how tall he used to be. He was blocking my sun.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death/evasiv/confess: From… no one. I guess I have to come clean. I killed him myself.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death/evasive: I heard about it… the cristal wastes are truly unforgiving.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death/evasive/lie: [Lie] I overheard someponies talk about it at the tavern.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death/player-murder: Because I did it myself. He was tough, but not tough enough.
cristal-den/bibin.water-carrier-death/potiok: The Potioks had him killed. They believed he was responsible for sabotaging their work at the coal mine.
